title: Multiplexed Imaging of Neuronal Synapses Using Nucleic Acid Probe Exchange
protocol: Ensure that the concentration of antibodies used for DNA modification is about 1 mg/mL.
Dilute or concentrate antibodies as needed in PBS buffer.
Wash Amicon Column Ultra 0.5 100 kDa cutoff with PBS buffer and centrifuge at 5000 g for 5 min.
Load antibody solution (100 μg of antibody) onto the column and centrifuge until the volume recovered is about 100 μL.
Wash Zeba columns three times with 300 μL of PBS buffer by centrifugation at 1500 g for 1 min each.
Load diluted or concentrated antibody solution (~100 μL) into a clean collection tube after loading it onto the Zeba column and centrifuge for 2 min at 1500 g.
Measure final concentration with nanodrop to ensure it is around 1 mg/mL.
Reconstitute DTT in 100 μL of PBS/EDTA solution to make a final concentration of 500 mM DTT.
Dissolve 25 nmoles of thiolated DNA at 1 mM in DNAse/RNAse free water.
Mix 25 μL of the DNA solution with 20 μL of the DTT reduction solution and 55 μL of PBS/EDTA buffer.
React the mix for 2 hours at room temperature on a shaker, wrapped in aluminum foil to protect from light.
Remove lid and cap from NAP-5 column and discard storage solution by passing through the column.
Wash the column with DNAse/RNAse free water three times, keeping the water level above the column filter to avoid drying.
Replace the cap and lid on the washed column.
Prepare SMCC linker at 10 mg/mL in 100% DMF.
Add SMCC linker to the antibody solution at a 1:7.5 molar ratio, realizing serial dilution with first dilution by a factor of 10 in DMF followed by PBS.
Ensure the final DMF concentration in the antibody solution is around 5%.
React for 1 hour and 30 min wrapped in aluminum foil to protect from light on a shaker at 4°C.
Use Zeba column 7KDa to remove excess SMCC linker.
Measure the concentration of antibodies using nanodrop.
Load 100 μL of DNA solution onto the washed NAP-5 column and add 400 μL of water immediately, allowing it to pass through the resin.
Add 1 mL of water when the previous addition reaches the top of the resin and start collecting drops in prepared tubes.
Prepare a micro BCA solution by mixing 500 μL of reagent A, 500 μL of reagent B, and 25 μL of reagent C.
Add 25 μL of the Micro BCA solution to each elutant starting from the last tube collected to test for DTT presence.
Discard tubes that show a purple reaction indicating DTT presence.
Use nanodrop to determine which tubes contain DNA when no further discarding occurs based on color change.
Pool the tubes containing the highest concentration of DNA and determine their concentration with Nanodrop.
Add reduced DNA to the antibody solution immediately at a 1:15 molar ratio excess.
Age the reaction overnight on a shaker at 4°C protected from light.
Use Ultra 0.5 100 kDa column to remove excess non-reacted DNA from antibody solution.
Wash the antibody solution 4 times with PBS at 5000 g for 5-10 min.
Determine final concentration of antibody using Nanodrop.
Resuspend amino modified DNA strands (5') at a concentration of 1 mM in DNase/RNase free water.
Resuspend ATTO 655 dye at 10 mg/mL in 100% DMF.
Mix 25 μL of DNA solution (25 nmole) with ATTO 655 dye in final volume of 500 μL PBS at a 10 x molar ratio excess.
Age the reaction overnight at 4°C on a shaker.
Add 100 uL of 3 M sodium acetate to the 500 μL solution and mix thoroughly.
Add 500 uL of -20°C 99.5% isopropanol to the mixture, mix thoroughly, and let at -20°C overnight.
Centrifuge DNA solution at 15000-20000 g for 3 hrs on a pre-chilled centrifuge at 4°C.
Discard supernatant without touching the pellet.
Add 500 μL of ice cold pure ethanol to the pellet.
Centrifuge for 15 min at 15000-20000 g.
Remove the supernatant carefully.
Dry the pellet at 37°C for at least 2 hours until complete drying of the pellet.
Resuspend the DNA in PBS.
Purify the DNA via HPLC on a Gilson GX-271 using a ProtoHiggins C18 column with a gradient of triethylammonium acetate and acetonitrile.

Prepare fixative solution by mixing 1 part of 20% paraformaldehyde solution with 4 parts of 5% sucrose solution in 1X PBS to achieve a final concentration of 4% wt/vol paraformaldehyde and 4% sucrose wt/vol in 1X PBS.
Remove the culture medium from cells cultured on 96-well plates.
Replace with 100 μL of fixative solution.
Fix cells for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash the cells three times with PBS to remove fixative solution.
Plates can be used immediately or stored at 4°C for later use.
Validate each newly conjugated antibody using immunofluorescence to ensure staining pattern specificity has not changed due to nucleic acid conjugation.
Perform serial dilution to determine the optimal dilution of the conjugated antibody, as the conjugation process may alter antibody affinity.
Permeabilize PFA fixed cells for 10 min at room temperature with permeabilization buffer.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Incubate the cells in the nuclear blocking buffer for 1 hr at room temperature.
Dilute DNA-conjugated anti-bassoon antibody and unconjugated anti-synapsin-I antibodies in the nuclear blocking buffer.
Incubate cells in the diluted primary antibody solution overnight at 4°C.
Wash cells 3 times with PBS at RT.
Dilute fluorophore conjugated secondary antibodies in the regular blocking buffer: goat-anti-rabbit-Alexa 488, goat-anti-mouse-Alexa 568.
Incubate the cells in diluted fluorophore conjugated secondary antibodies at room temperature for 1 hr.
Wash cells 3 times with PBS.
Dilute DAPI or Hoechst in PBS.
Incubate cells in diluted DAPI for 15 min or Hoechst for 3 min.
Wash cells 3 times with PBS and image the plate at the channels of 405, 488, 568 on the microscope.
Permeabilize PFA fixed cells for 10 min at room temperature with permeabilization buffer.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Incubate the cells in the regular blocking buffer for 1 hr at room temperature.
Dilute unconjugated anti-bassoon antibody raised in mouse and unconjugated anti-synapsin-1 raised in rabbits antibodies in the regular blocking buffer.
Incubate cells in the diluted primary antibody solution overnight at 4°C.
Wash cells 3 times with PBS.
Incubate the cells in the nuclear blocking buffer for 1 hr at room temperature.
Dilute the DNA-conjugated goat-anti-mouse secondary antibody in the nuclear blocking buffer.
Incubate the cells in diluted DNA-conjugated secondary antibodies at room temperature for 1 hr.
Wash cells 3 times with PBS.
Dilute the fluorophore conjugated secondary antibodies in the regular blocking buffer: donkey-anti-mouse-Alexa 488, donkey-anti-rabbit-Alexa 568.
Incubate the cells in diluted fluorescently labeled secondary antibodies at room temperature for 1 hr.
Wash cells 3 times with PBS.
Dilute DAPI or Hoechst in PBS.
Incubate cells in diluted DAPI for 15 min or Hoechst for 3 min, wash 3 times with PBS, and image the plate at the channels of 405, 488, 568 on the microscope.
Fix 10 wells of cells following the fixation protocol.
Permeabilize the cells for 10 minutes at room temperature with permeabilization buffer.
Wash the cells twice with PBS.
Incubate cells in the RNase solution at 37°C for 1 hour.
Wash the cells three times with PBS.
Block cells for 1 hour at room temperature with regular blocking buffer.
Dilute chicken MAP2 antibodies in regular buffer for group A wells.
Dilute PSD95 and NMDAR2B primary antibodies separately in regular blocking buffer for group B wells.
Incubate cells in diluted primary antibodies overnight at 4°C.
Wash the cells three times with 1X PBS.
Dilute goat-anti-chicken-Alexa 488 secondary antibody in regular blocking buffer for group A wells.
For group B, dilute goat-anti-chicken-Alexa 647 and goat-anti-rabbit-p1 in nuclear blocking buffer for the well stained with anti-PSD95 antibody.
For group B, dilute goat-anti-chicken-Alexa 488 and goat-anti-mouse-p12 in nuclear blocking buffer for the well stained with anti-NMDAR2B antibody.
Incubate cells in diluted secondary antibodies at room temperature for 1 hour.
Wash cells three times with PBS.
Fix cells using the fixation protocol.
Block the cells for 30 minutes at room temperature with the nuclear blocking buffer.

Dilute each of the following DNA-conjugated primary antibodies separately in nuclear blocking buffer: phalloidin-p2, Tuj1-p3, cortactin-p4, Shank3-p6, ARPC2-p7, bassoon-p8, synapsin-I-p9, Homer-1b/c-p10.
Incubate cells for group A with diluted DNA-conjugated primary antibodies.
Keep cells for group B in the nuclear blocking buffer overnight at 4°C.
Wash cells three times with PBS.
Incubate cells in diluted Hoechst for 3 minutes.
Wash cells three times with PBS.
Acquire baseline images by imaging a z-stack at 405, 488, and 647 channels using a Phenix high-content confocal imaging system from Perkin Elmer.
Dilute LNA probes to 10 nM in imaging buffer immediately before incubation with cells.
Incubate cells in the first diluted probe for 5 minutes.
Wash cells twice with imaging buffer to remove free probe.
Image cells again on the same field of views.
Wash cells three times with wash buffer.
Incubate cells in the wash buffer for five minutes after the last wash.
Image cells again.
Repeat steps 18-22 for each probe.
Fix cells using the fixation protocol.
Permeabilize cells for 10 min at room temperature with permeabilization buffer and wash twice with PBS.
Incubate cells in RNase solution at 37°C for 1 hour, then wash three times with PBS.
Incubate cells in regular blocking buffer for 1 hour at room temperature.
Dilute MAP2, vGluT1, PSD95, NMDAR2B primary antibodies in regular blocking buffer.
Incubate cells in diluted primary antibodies overnight at 4°C.
Wash cells three times with 1X PBS.
Incubate cells in nuclear blocking buffer for 1 hour at room temperature.
Dilute goat-anti-chicken-Alexa 488, goat-anti-guinea pig-Alexa555 and goat-anti-rabbit-p1, goat-anti-mouse-p12 secondary antibodies in nuclear blocking buffer.
Incubate cells in diluted secondary antibodies at room temperature for 1 hour.
Wash cells three times with 1X PBS.
Post-fix cells for 15 min using fixative solution.
Wash the cells 3 times with 1X PBS.
Incubate the cells in the nuclear blocking buffer for 30 min at room temperature.
Dilute phalloidin-p2, Tuj1-p3, cortactin-p4, Shank3-p6, ARPC2-p7, bassoon-p8, synapsin-I-p9, and Homer-1b/c-p10 DNA-conjugated primary antibodies in the nuclear blocking buffer.
Incubate cells in diluted primary antibodies overnight at 4°C.
Wash cells 3 times with PBS.
Dilute DAPI or Hoechst in PBS.
Incubate cells in diluted DAPI or Hoechst for 15 min, then wash 3 times with PBS.
Acquire baseline images. Image a z-stack at 405, 488, 568, and 647 channels using a Phenix high-content confocal imaging system from Perkin Elmer.
Dilute the first LNA probes to 10 nM in the imaging buffer right before introduction to the cells.
Incubate cells in the first diluted probe for 5 min, then wash twice with imaging buffer to remove free probe.
Image cells again on the same field of views. The staining pattern of the target labeled with the corresponding docking strand sequence should be visible at 647 channel.
Wash the cells 3 times with wash buffer and incubate in wash buffer for 5 min after the last wash.
Image cells again to confirm all wells show low background fluorescence at 647 channel close to baseline images.
Repeat steps for each probe.
Repeat the procedure 3 times by using 3 different batches of neuronal cultures.
